title.narrative: Sustainable Use of Natural Resources for Environment and Econ. Dev.-SUNREED
Sustainable Use of Natural Resources for Environment and Econ. Dev.-SUNREED

description.narrative:
Det övergripande målet med konceptförslaget "Hållbar användning av naturresurser för miljö och ekonomisk utveckling" är att öka en hållbar användning av privata skogsresurser och utveckling av värdekedjan för förnybar energi baserad på träbiomassa (fjärrvärmesystem) som kommer att generera en större mängd skogsvaror och inkomstmöjligheter för hushåll på landsbygden. Målet för projektförslagen kommer att uppnås genom följande två resultat: Resultat 1: Privata skogsägare har ökat värdet och hållbarheten i skogsståndens ekosystem. Resultat 2: Värdekedjornas aktörer har ökat produktionen, bearbetningen och slutanvändningen av träbiomassa.
Genomförandepartner är CNVP Foundation. Projektet kommer att inriktas på att ta itu med de privata skogsägarnas centrala begränsningar och ge stöd till dem när det gäller att samla in bevis och förespråka politiska och rättsliga förändringar med offentliga institutioner till förmån för privat skogsbruk.

The overall objective of the concept proposal “Sustainable Use of Natural Resources for Environment and Economic Development, shortly SUNREED” is to increase the sustainable use of private forest resources and value chain development on renewable energy based on wood biomass (district heating system) that will generate a higher volume of forest goods and income opportunities to rural households. The project proposals goal will be achieved through the following two outcomes: Outcome 1: Private forest owners have increased value and sustainability of the forest stand ecosystems. Outcome 2: Value chains actors have increased wood biomass production, processing and final use.
The implementing partner is CNVP Foundation. The project will be focused on addressing key constraint faced by the private forest owners and provide support to them in collecting evidence and advocating for policy and legal changes with public institutions in favor of private forestry.

title.narrative: SUSTAINABLE USE OF NATURAL RESOURCES FOR ENVIRONMENT AND ECON. DEV.SUNREED
SUSTAINABLE USE OF NATURAL RESOURCES FOR ENVIRONMENT AND ECON. DEV.SUNREED
Mid-term Review of Sustainable Use of Natural Resources and Economic Development (SUNREED)

description.narrative:
In 2025, the Sustainable Use of Natural Resources for Environment and Economic Development (SUNREED) project showed clear progress in promoting sustainable private forestry, green business development and rural economic opportunities in Kosovo.
By the end of 2025, 310 private forest owners were implementing forest management plans covering more than 1,500 hectares. Of this area, 400 hectares were under thinning and other silvicultural measures. This indicates a shift from passive forest ownership towards more active and sustainable forest management.
SUNREED also supported 21 partnerships with a total value of EUR 961,309. Partner co-investment nearly matched the projects contribution, showing strong ownership from the private sector. Ten surveyed enterprises increased their combined turnover from EUR 782,722 in 2023 to EUR 2.13 million in 2025. These enterprises also reported 280 new jobs, including 127 jobs held by women. Women-led or women-benefiting enterprises represented 40 percent of the supported portfolio.
The project contributed to trade and market development by helping enterprises improve processing, strengthen buyer-supplier relations, access new markets and prepare for EU-oriented requirements. Support included business-to-business activities and participation in trade fairs in Sweden, including ELMIA Wood and the Nordic Organic Food Fair. Partnerships with enterprises such as Agroprodukt, Dardani, PromoPlast, BEEPRO and non-wood forest product producers contributed to improved production, import substitution, domestic and regional market links, and emerging export potential.
At policy level, SUNREED contributed to stronger recognition of private forestry in Kosovo. This included support linked to the inclusion of Measure 11 on private forestry in Kosovos 2026 Rural Development Program and the announcement of a National Funding Program for Private Forests. The National Association of Private Forest Owners and local associations also strengthened their planning, reporting and financial management capacities.
Overall, the 2025 results suggest that private forestry is becoming more relevant for Kosovo's green transition, rural economic development and sustainable use of natural resources.
